launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Launcher v2.4.12: crash card only for NEW crashes, close-after-launch really closes, game fully detached from the launcher (Task-Manager-proof). Client v3.0.0: KUI native Java/OpenGL UI framework (new main menu, world selector, multiplayer, ClickGUI + more), Microsoft account switch fixed, FPS regression fixed (Unlock FPS restored + config repair), client cosmetics now persist to your Kinetrix account.
